Lily wrote about the day in the diary. Lily learned a lot about music. Lily is going to travel to Toronto in February. The volleyball match starts at three.
Last Thursday, Lily and David went to the park path. Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the running track. My sister was born on a snowy night.
Lily wants to be a engineer in the future. Lily usually has dumplings for breakfast. Lily thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Best of all, rain came pouring down as we ran to the car.
Lily hopes to visit Toronto one day. The weather was snowy that day. Lily and David had great fun there.
